descricoes_referencias.design_anime_aprovado.png: the APPROVED anime character design of Garota — follow it exactly (face, hair, outfit, colors)

texto_fixo.trava: CHARACTER LOCK: Garota. Appearance: drawn EXACTLY like the manga reference: slim young woman with a soft round face and a narrow pointed chin, very long straight solid-black hair parted in the middle falling past her waist, two thin antenna-like loose strands, big perfectly round pale eyes with a tiny black dot pupil and a few long lower lashes, a tiny dot nose, small mouth, pointed elf-like ears showing through the hair, rough loose ink lines; colors: black hair, gray eyes, soft pink cheeks, a loose burgundy knit cardigan with rolled sleeves over a dark charcoal camisole, dark gray loose pants, barefoot, fair skin. Keep exactly the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, body, outfit and colors in every image (follow the approved design reference).
texto_fixo.estilo: ART STYLE: colored anime adaptation that keeps the ORIGINAL MANGA ARTIST'S drawing style exactly: the same hand-drawn loose ink linework with varied, slightly rough line weight, hatching kept as texture in the shadows, the same character proportions and face shapes (as in the manga references), flat muted colors laid under the black ink lines like a hand-colored manga page, soft limited shading, subtle paper grain — NOT generic glossy anime; FAITHFUL TO THE MANGA: copy the original artist's line art and character drawing style from the manga references (face shape, eye shape and pupils, nose, hair silhouette, body proportions).
texto_fixo.regras: ONE single figure, framed as the pose says, seen in a 3/4 view turned to the RIGHT side of the image, the whole figure inside the image with margin. NO furniture, NO chair, NO table, NO desk, NO floor, NO background objects (a sitting pose sits on NOTHING — an invisible CHAIR-HEIGHT seat: hips at knee height, thighs level, lower legs down to the feet; NEVER sitting on the floor or kneeling unless the pose says so; the furniture is a separate layer); a small handheld object only if the pose needs it. No panels, on a flat solid chroma-key green background (#00FF00), no shadow on the background. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT in the image: no letters, no words, no speech balloons, no thought bubbles, no sound-effect onomatopoeia lettering, no captions, no narration boxes, no signs or labels with writing, no watermark. If the reference images contain speech balloons, lettering or sound effects, do NOT copy them.
